rows.note: Use this as the everyday all-purpose choice when people, things, or arrangements harmonize or fit together.

example.english: These two colours are really attuned to each other.
example.traditional: 呢兩種顏色襯埋一齊好夾。
example.jyutping: ne1 loeng5 zung2 ngaan4 sik1 can3 maai4 jat1 cai4 hou2 gaap3

rows.note: Use this when “attuned” means synchronized with a process, system, or phenomenon rather than simply fitting well.

example.english: The system has to be attuned to the new process to avoid errors.
example.traditional: 個系統要同新程序同步，先至唔會出錯。
example.jyutping: go3 hai6 tung2 jiu3 tung4 san1 cing4 zeoi6 tung4 bou6 sin1 zi3 m4 wui5 ceot1 co3

rows.note: Use this for a musical instrument or singing that is in the correct pitch.

example.english: The piano has to be attuned for the song to sound good.
example.traditional: 部鋼琴要啱音，首歌先至好聽。
example.jyutping: bou6 gong3 kam4 jiu3 ngaam1 jam1 sau2 go1 sin1 zi3 hou2 teng1
